title: OpenHands (default)
description: OpenHands on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: OpenHands (Standard)
de.description: OpenHands an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur sein Modell ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: Anthropic's API with your key (sandbox-ai secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY once); OpenHands sees a placeholder, the connection proxy puts the key in on the wire, and --model names the model (LiteLLM's anthropic/...). Another provider: --api-key api.openai.com=OPENAI_API_KEY or openrouter.ai=OPENROUTER_API_KEY with its --model, or a server of yours with --llm (the preset openhands-local-llm); OpenHands has no maker's model service of its own.

OpenHands' interactive surface is the Agent Canvas, its web UI on the sandbox's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:8000/): add --browser to see it in the sandbox's own browser, which starts on it (the app's Browser button; Podman). One task without the UI: sandbox-ai openhands -- task "TASK".
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-openhands or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
OpenHands is not live-tested yet (a start says so); its image first: sandbox-ai build openhands (a start builds it when it is missing).
